description: This file implements a simplistic, dynamically resizable FIFO (First In - First Out) buffer in C. It provides functions for creating, cloning, destroying, resetting, pushing data, pulling data, and managing internal buffer capacity, primarily used for temporary memory storage between components or threads without thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: _icFifoBuff
classes.description: Internal structure representing the FIFO buffer with pointers and positional indices.

methods.name: fifoBuffCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new FIFO buffer with specified initial size or default size.

methods.name: fifoBuffClone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an existing FIFO buffer.

methods.name: fifoBuffDestroy
methods.description: Frees memory associated with the FIFO buffer and destroys it.

methods.name: fifoBuffClear
methods.description: Resets the buffer's read and write positions without freeing memory.

methods.name: fifoBuffGetPushAvailable
methods.description: Returns the amount of free space available for pushing data.

methods.name: fifoBuffPush
methods.description: Appends data to the buffer, ensuring capacity beforehand.

methods.name: fifoBuffPushByte
methods.description: Appends a single byte to the buffer.

methods.name: fifoBuffPushPointer
methods.description: Provides a pointer to internal buffer space for direct data injection.

methods.name: fifoBuffAfterPushPointer
methods.description: Updates internal structure after direct buffer injection.

methods.name: fifoBuffGetPullAvailable
methods.description: Returns the amount of data available to pull.

methods.name: fifoBuffPull
methods.description: Extracts data from the buffer into a destination, updating read position.

methods.name: fifoBuffPullPointer
methods.description: Provides a pointer to internal buffer space for direct reading.

methods.name: fifoBuffAfterPullPointer
methods.description: Updates internal structure after direct buffer reading.
